shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin struggles near $60K due to significant ETF outflows, indicating weak institutional capital exposure in June.
Federal Reserve's hawkish stance and potential rate hikes due to persistent inflation are headwinds for crypto.
US-Iran tensions escalate, pushing oil prices higher and increasing global market risk aversion.
Europe's MiCA regulatory framework enters full enforcement on July 1, affecting exchange operations and user migration.
MicroStrategy authorized $1.25B in BTC sales and paused new purchases, shifting to balance sheet optimization.
